nodes.label: Digest
nodes.description: AI-Powered Cross-Platform Technology News Application — the main product of this project.

nodes.label: System Architecture & Component Diagram
nodes.description: Architecture document describing the overall system design: Flutter frontend, FastAPI backend, Postgres, Redis, Supabase, Gemini.

nodes.label: SQLAlchemy
nodes.description: Async ORM used with asyncpg to interact with PostgreSQL.

nodes.label: Supabase
nodes.description: Auth and user identity provider. Issues JWTs verified by FastAPI middleware.

nodes.label: Content Pipeline (System A)
nodes.description: Background FastAPI job running every 15-30 minutes: pulls RSS feeds, cleans HTML, dedupes articles, stores in Postgres.

nodes.label: digest_news_app (Flutter)
nodes.description: Cross-platform Flutter app (iOS/Android). AI-powered tech news aggregator with TTS and offline caching.

nodes.label: Alembic Migrations
nodes.description: Database migration tool used to version-control the PostgreSQL schema.

nodes.label: Technical Architecture Document
nodes.description: Detailed technical architecture document for Digest covering data flow, infrastructure decisions, and deployment.

nodes.label: Preset AI Questions
nodes.description: Fixed set of AI angles per article: core summary, 'Explain simpler', 'Why does this matter', 'What's the risk'. Makes AI calls cacheable.

nodes.label: Offline Support
nodes.description: Flutter app stores recent article cards in Hive locally; bookmarks queued offline then flushed when reconnected.

nodes.label: Functional Specification Document
nodes.description: Full FSD for Digest — detailed functional spec covering all features, user flows, and system interactions.

nodes.label: Product Requirements Document
nodes.description: Full PRD for Digest v1.0 — defines scope, functional/non-functional requirements, data architecture, API contract, mobile architecture, delivery roadmap.

nodes.label: BeautifulSoup4
nodes.description: HTML cleaning library used to strip ads/nav clutter from article bodies.

nodes.label: Dio (HTTP client)
nodes.description: HTTP client for Flutter. Used in news_api_service.dart to call the FastAPI backend.

nodes.label: Redis (hiredis)
nodes.description: In-memory cache layer (Upstash Redis on free tier). First tier in the 3-tier caching strategy.

nodes.label: Feature Backlog
nodes.description: Jira/GitHub-style sprint-ready feature tickets organized into epics: DB & Infra, Ingestion, API, Flutter, AI, Auth, Testing.

nodes.label: Google Gemini API
nodes.description: LLM used for AI summarization and preset Q&A. Free-tier usage; accessed only on cache miss.

nodes.label: flutter_tts
nodes.description: On-device TTS library wrapped by tts_service.dart in the Flutter app.

nodes.label: Text-to-Speech (TTS)
nodes.description: On-device TTS reads article summaries aloud via flutter_tts.

nodes.label: RSS Ingestion
nodes.description: Pulls and parses RSS feeds from curated tech news sources. Deduplicates by canonical URL and content hash.

nodes.label: APScheduler
nodes.description: Python job scheduler used to run the RSS ingestion pipeline every 15-30 minutes.

nodes.label: feedparser
nodes.description: Python library for parsing RSS/Atom feeds in the ingestion pipeline.

nodes.label: FastAPI
nodes.description: Python web framework for the backend API layer and ingestion pipeline.

nodes.label: slowapi
nodes.description: Rate limiting middleware for FastAPI endpoints.

nodes.label: Three-Tier Caching
nodes.description: Redis (in-memory) → Postgres summaries table → Gemini API. Cheapest first; Gemini only reached on cold miss.

nodes.label: API Layer (System B)
nodes.description: Request/response FastAPI side: serves feed, summaries, HN signals, bookmarks on-demand. Stateless and heavily cached.

nodes.label: flutter_riverpod
nodes.description: State management for the Flutter app. Providers hold feed state, bookmarks, followed tags.

nodes.label: HN / Reddit Community Signals
nodes.description: Upvote/comment counts from Hacker News (Algolia API) and Reddit, displayed alongside bookmarked articles.

nodes.label: Graphify Agent Rule
nodes.description: Agent rule instructing the AI assistant to use graphify for codebase queries.
